0022600151.text: The Cavaliers (3-1) are 2nd in the Central, 0.5 games back, and 5th in the East, riding a three-game winning streak with a 3-0 home record and a 0-1 road mark, though Meleek Thomas is out with a foot injury after averaging 13.0 points and 19.8 minutes per game this season. The Bucks (1-4) are 5th in the Central, 3 games back, and 14th in the East, coming off a one-game losing streak with a 1-2 home record and an 0-2 road record. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Cavaliers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 123-116 victory in Milwaukee on March 17, 2026.
